Modules

One core. Five modules.

The modules add research, specs, verification, and deployment to Forge. They all stand on a shared foundation.

Book a demo

  1. Forge. Turns a spec into finished, verified code.

  2. Anvil. Clarifies the spec before any code is written.

  3. Temper. Verifies that your app works.

  4. Bellows. Finds what’s worth building.

  5. Rivet. Deploys only a verified, approved version.

  6. Cognera Harness. A shared foundation for Forge and its modules.
